design.page_look: only the reference page's values, read with get-structure

notes: project_id is optional; the lookup filters by game status only, not by project
icon, cover and media[] are media UIDs, not URLs; resolve each through the media endpoint
typed fields are the contract; attributes{} and extra_data{} repeat some of them and may disagree
one tile per game; cover is a public URL here (a UID on the game endpoint)
filters by project AND status; a slug that resolves on the game endpoint may be absent here
mode=buy lists games sold as keys (key_price {amount, currency}); mode=top_up lists games with in-game currency (currency_name)
a game without a storefront listing of that mode is absent under an explicit mode
size above 50 is rejected with 400; the response has no total

payment_methods_rules: empty list = not recorded = the game is payable with any provider
id is the {provider} URL segment (paypal, toss, klarna, ...), case-sensitive as stored; lowercase both sides before matching
payment_method_id is the Pay Station PID enabled in the GAME's Store project; a PID from another project fails with Pay Station error 3010
countries empty = every country; ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 otherwise
order matters; the first entry for a provider is the fallback when the viewer's country is unknown
a provider may appear several times (one entry per country configuration)

behavior: slugs come from the catalog without a mode filter, so every catalog game gets a path
slugs equal to an existing static page path are dropped
linked data provider is created automatically: ugc-d-data-game-provider-v2

limits.api_calls_per_game_getData: 1 core-attributes + up to 22 media lookups (cover, icon, 20 media)

pin_rule: pin every block to the exact version on the reference page of its page type (read with get-structure)
pre-release builds are allowed only when the reference page already runs them

hero.warning: 0.2.0 (published 2026-10-19) sorts above every newer build; a stable fallback would pick an older hero

row_input.provider: lowercase id, the {provider} URL segment; must match payment_methods[].id
row_input.partner_logo_url: URL, optional (a text badge is shown without it)

seo.title: from row
seo.rule: no reference to any data provider; a static page whose SEO references a provider the page lacks is dropped from publishing without an error

combined.hand_typed_content: co-brand fields only, copied from the provider row
combined.pay_station_lock: PID = payment_methods[] entry with id == provider for the viewer's country, else the first entry for that provider. payment_methods is not a data provider output: the agent neither binds nor types it.

batch.dynamic_pages: The agent creates each dynamic page once (game, and one combined page per provider). The number of game paths equals the number of catalog games and is set by the XLA Pages API, not by the batch. Per-game exclusions are not possible in the paths provider: a game is excluded by removing it from the catalog or by a redirect, not by the agent.
batch.static_pages: one row per payment provider page

row_example.hero_description: Buy your favorite games now and pay later with Klarna

responses: the agent makes only GET requests, only to https://xla-pages.xsolla.com/pub/*
each response is saved as is, with its URL, status and the time of the request
scripts read the saved files and make no HTTP calls
the report shows the request time of every response it used

per_game.on_fail: no page is generated for this game

per_game.check: slug is in catalog mode=buy or mode=top_up for ${project_id}
per_game.on_fail: no page is generated for this game

per_game.check: title is non-empty and at most 60 characters
cover resolves through /pub/media/{id}/info with content_type image/*
per_game.on_fail: hero renders without an image; fix in the API
hero cannot start a purchase; fix in the API

per_game.check: buy games: catalog key_price or game_key_price is present
per_game.on_fail: no price shown; fix in the API
combined page FAQ is empty; fix in the API
items after the 20th are not shown

per_provider_and_game.check: payment_methods is empty OR contains the provider (lowercased)
per_provider_and_game.on_fail: the combined page still exists as a path; the game cannot be paid with this provider; list for a redirect

preflight.output: one line per game with the failing checks and where to fix them

writes.target: The draft of the one site in site.shop_builder, never a copy of it. Edits stay in the draft until a person publishes. The site is live and the Pages team publishes it themselves: their publication also ships the agent's draft, so nothing is written before the plan's yes.
writes.published_site: The rule "never write to a published site" stays. The one exception is the site in site.shop_builder (merchant, project and slug all equal); every other published site is refused.
allowed: add the blocks listed for the page type, in the listed order, at the pinned version
set the listed bindings and settings
write the listed row content into the listed fields
hide an optional block (required: false) when its content is empty
delete the blocks add-page seeded on a page created in the same run (delete, not hide; a hidden block stays in the structure)
set a page's look (background, width, spacing) to the reference page's values, read with get-structure
forbidden: any block not listed for the page type, standard or custom
Custom code (HTML) block, block scripts, style layers, partner customization bundles, external scripts, iframes, fonts or trackers
theme, font, color, radius, spacing or block style patches, except a page look set to the reference page's values
any page look value the reference page does not have
deleting or moving a block that was on a page before the run, or hiding one other than an optional manifest block
typing game data (titles, prices, SKUs, images, FAQ) into a block instead of binding it
duplicating a block that has data bindings (add it fresh from the block package instead)
publishing; a person publishes, all pages of the site at once
writing to the XLA Pages API
writing to the catalog or LiveOps
writes.approval: one plan per batch listing every page, its type and its blocks, and every page that appears or changes; nothing is written before approval
writes.backup: The agent's own get-structure snapshot, saved before the first write. Shop Builder's version history is not a backup: restoring a version currently drops the data-provider connections.
writes.cli_gate: Writes run only when `--help` lists every command and flag the plan needs (scripts/cli_gate.py). The CLI version number is not checked.

before_write: every block in the plan is listed for its page type, at its pinned version, in order
no theme or style patch in the plan
every static row passes the character limits
the saved /pub responses are at most 24 hours old
every command and flag the plan needs is in the CLI's --help
any failure stops the batch with zero writes
after_write: read every page back with get-structure and compare with this manifest (blocks, order, versions, bindings)
on update, the set of data bindings per page is identical before and after
report per page: pass, or the exact difference
